title: Make small controls at least 44px to tap (theme toggle, calendar arrows, close X, select and menu rows, switches, tabs, score buttons)
request: please fix everything that comes up, dont just wait until you are done with a task to ask me if you can fix (the audit found controls smaller than the 44px tap size this app uses for buttons)

criteria.text: Theme toggle (header, every page): at least 44px wide and tall; before: 42px wide
Calendar Previous and Next Month arrows: at least 44px wide; before: 28px wide (day cells stay 36px wide on purpose so seven fit a 320px phone, and are 44px tall)
Dialog close X: a tap area of at least 44px with the same look; before: 16px
Select triggers are 44px tall like text fields; before: 40px. Select options and user-menu items are at least 44px tall on touch screens (desktop rows unchanged); before: 36px
Tabs: tap area at least 44px tall with the same look; before: 42px
Switches (Double Header, Batch Match, Avoid rematches and others): tap area at least 44px tall with the same look; before: 24px
Remove buttons (Remove match pair, Remove signup, hero card remove): at least 44px wide; before: 40px, 32px and 32px
Admin Scores result buttons (2–0, 2–1, 1–2, 0–2) are at least 44px wide on every phone; before: 38.5px wide at 320px

No invisible tap area covers the centre of another control on the audited screens; nothing else moves (same text and layout at 768 and 1280px, no new console errors, no sideways scroll); existing tests pass and each new test fails on the old code
